summary: Raw HTML is passed through by default (allow_html=True), so any Markdown from users can inject <script> tags.
exploit_hint: A post body or bio containing <script>...</script> is rendered as-is.

summary: save_upload() joins the client-supplied filename onto upload_dir, so '../' in the filename writes outside the upload folder. Fixed silently ('Improved filename handling').
exploit_hint: Upload with filename '../../x.png' and it lands two folders above the upload directory.

summary: pages is computed with floor division, so the last partial page is dropped (7 items at 5 per page gives 1 page).
